scope: One-paper finishing check for candidate-specific beta-cell secretory function at baseline and after immune challenge. No new statistical analysis, candidate selection, or exhaustive immunology extraction.

article.title: Protective Renalase Deficiency in β-Cells Shapes Immune Metabolism and Function in Autoimmune Diabetes

endpoint_inventory.locator: Methods: Seahorse Metabolic Flux Assay; Figure 1C–D
endpoint_inventory.endpoint: Basal extracellular acidification and oxygen consumption of WT versus Rnls-mutant NIT-1 cells.
endpoint_inventory.classification: Metabolic measurements before immune challenge; no insulin or C-peptide secretion readout.

endpoint_inventory.locator: Methods: CD4+ T-Cell Proliferation Assay; Figure 1E–F
endpoint_inventory.endpoint: CD4 T-cell division during 72-hour direct or transwell coculture with WT versus Rnls-mutant NIT-1 cells.
endpoint_inventory.classification: Immune-cell functional assay, not beta-cell secretory function.

endpoint_inventory.locator: Methods: In Vivo Splenocyte Transfer Mouse Model and Graft Isolation; Figure 2B–D; Figure 4A
endpoint_inventory.endpoint: Paired NIT-1 graft weight after diabetogenic splenocyte transfer at days 10 and 17, with a separate no-immune graft-weight comparison.
endpoint_inventory.classification: Graft-mass protection endpoint; not secretory or glycemic function. Adenoma-derived NIT-1 model limits physiologic beta-cell generalization.

endpoint_inventory.endpoint: Immune-cell composition, transcriptomic profiles and surface markers in grafts or draining lymph nodes.
endpoint_inventory.classification: Immune profiling, not direct beta-cell secretion.

endpoint_inventory.endpoint: PD-L1 overexpression or blockade with graft-weight and immune endpoints.
endpoint_inventory.classification: Protection-context manipulation, not direct beta-cell secretion.

endpoint_inventory.endpoint: Immune subsets and activation markers in graft/spleen/pancreas or lymph nodes, paired graft weight, and MHC-II expression.
endpoint_inventory.classification: Immune and graft-mass endpoints; no insulin/C-peptide assay.

endpoint_inventory.endpoint: Immune-cell sorting, UMAPs, macrophage/T-cell expression signatures, and dendritic-cell pathway enrichment.
endpoint_inventory.classification: The protein-secretion pathway label in Supplemental Figure 5b concerns dendritic-cell gene enrichment, not measured beta-cell insulin secretion.

determination.statement: No candidate-specific direct beta-cell secretory-function comparison was located in the complete Bode 2023 main text and publisher supplements assessed, either before or after immune challenge.
determination.interpretation: This completes source assessment. It does not establish failed secretion, zero biological effect, or absence of an unpublished experiment. Metabolic flux and T-cell function cannot substitute for beta-cell secretory function.

proposed_update.action: Replace abstract-limited access status with completed-source-assessment status and cite this assessment. Retain a nonexperimental source-assessment record rather than adding every immunology comparison.
proposed_update.counts: No additional baseline or post-immune secretory-function comparison should be counted. The primary statistical result and statistical files are unchanged.
proposed_update.narrative: Remove the now-obsolete statement that Bode 2023 full text/supplements remain inaccessible; state that full source review found graft/immune endpoints without a direct secretion comparison.
